title: Percentages
summary: Fractions in disguise: percentages as fractions and decimals, percentages of amounts, and percentage change.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 1: Fractions in Disguise

objectives: I can convert between fractions, decimals and percentages.
I can find a percentage of an amount.
I can calculate percentage increase and decrease.
misconceptions: Percentage change is divided by the new value.
A 50% increase then a 50% decrease gets you back to the start.
Percentages can never be more than 100%.
